verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for a SaaS product like cfo.ai, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only an MCP server, an MCP tools page, and a setup command. The OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, and cfo.ai issues no API keys. Nothing in the pack documents an explorable API reference with runnable examples, and MCP tool docs are an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.
